## CleanTalk

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/cleantalk/>

**Everest Forms** now integrates with** CleanTalk**, a powerful anti-spam solution that helps protect your WordPress forms from spam submissions, bot attacks, and other threats.

`Prerequisite:
- Active installation of the Everest Forms plugin .
- Access Key from the CleanTalk (free registration available).`

## Setting Up CleanTalk Integration Using Everest Forms

Follow these simple steps to use CleanTalk’s anti-spam services directly within Everest Forms:

### Step 1: Access CleanTalk Settings

- Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to **Everest Forms** > **Settings > Security,** and click on the **Integrations** tab.

- Locate and click the **CleanTalk** setting.

3. The CleanTalk configuration panel will appear, where you need to enter the **Access Key** for **CleanTalk**.

### Step 2: Add Your Access Key for CleanTalk

If you don’t have a CleanTalk access key yet:

- Go to CleanTalk website .

- Register to create a free CleanTalk account.

- Once registered, your dashboard will display your access key.

- Copy the access key.

If you already have an account:

- Log in to your CleanTalk dashboard .

- Navigate to the **“Access keys”** section.

- Copy your existing access key.

4. Return to your Everest Forms > Settings > Security > Integration > CleanTalk.
5. Paste the access key in the **“Access Key”** field.
6. Click **“Save Changes”** to store your configuration.

The integration is now active on your website.

#### Step 2: Enable Cleantalk for Individual Form

Now, open the desired form to add CleanTalk protection.

- Navigate to **Settings > Anti-Spam and Security**. You’ll see the **CleanTalk **tab, which you can toggle to enable.

2. Now, choose the **Protection type** for the form:

- **Mark as Spam:** This option accepts the submission but flags it as spam in your entries, allowing you to review it later.

- **Reject Submission: **This option will completely reject spam submissions, showing an error message to the user.

After configuring your desired anti-spam settings, be sure to click the **SAVE** button in the top-right corner to apply your changes.

If the spammers try to submit the form on your website, they’ll get a similar error as shown in the image below:

If you encounter errors in your form settings, as shown in the image below:

Click on **Add Key **to verify the access key.

Once you successfully enable CleanTalk on your form, it will protect your form against spam. For more anti-spam and security options, read our comprehensive documentation .

## Slack Integration

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/slack/>

## Installation

- Firstly, you need to purchase the Everest Forms Pro plugin.

- After the successful purchase, you will get the plugin zip file under your WPEverest account page.

- Now, you can download the **Everest Forms Pro** from there.

- Through your WordPress Dashboard, visit **Plugins -> Add New -> Upload** and then choose the downloaded zip file, and then install and activate it.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons -> All Features.**

- Search **Slack** add-on and install it.

## Setup and Configuration

After enabling the **Slack**, you can directly integrate the the Everest Forms with the desired **Slcak Channel** by following steps:

- Go to **Everest Forms > All Forms**.

- Edit a form. Or, create a new form from scratch.

- Go to Form **Settings > Slack**

Here, you can provide the **Slack Message Title, Slack Incoming Webhook and Slack Message. **To generate the **Slack Incoming Webhook, **refer to this doc: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks#create_a_webhook

On the Slack Message, you can put the content of the message as per your need. Use the smart tags to map form field values. Click on the <> button and use the available form fields as smart tags.

## Telegram Integration

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/telegram/>

## Installation

- Firstly, you need to purchase the Everest Forms Pro plugin.

- After the successful purchase, you will get the plugin zip file under your WPEverest account page.

- Now, you can download the **Everest Forms Pro** from there.

- Through your WordPress Dashboard, visit **Plugins -> Add New -> Upload** and then choose the downloaded zip file, and then install and activate it.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **Telegram** add-on and install it.

## Configuration

To integrate Telegram with your contact forms, you will need a Telegram API key.

### Generating Telegram API key

A bot has to be created by the customer to start the configuration process so that they integrate Telegram with Everest Forms.

- Open the Telegram Messenger and sign in to your account, or create a new one if you have not already.

- Enter **@BotFather** in the search tab and choose the relevant bot.

**Note:** The official Telegram bots have a tick mark on their name.

- Click **Start** to activate the **BotFather** bot. You will receive a list of commands to manage the bots.

- Choose or type the **/newbot** command and click **Send**.

- You will need to choose a name for the bot and then a username. The username has the ‘_bot’ prefix.

You will get the API key once you create the username for the bot. You can type and send /token to receive the API key again.

- Copy the API key to your clipboard.

### Integrating Telegram with Everest Forms

#### Authorizing API

Once you have generated the API key, go to the following location.

Everest Forms > Settings > Integration > Telegram

- Insert the generated API Key and provide the integration with a nickname.

- Click on the **Connect to Telegram **button. Once connected, you will see the following.

#### Creating a Telegram Group for Group ID

You will need a Telegram group once you have integrated the Telegram to the Everest Forms. But before that, search for the **JsonDumpBot** channel and click on the **Start **button in this channel.

- Forward any message from the group you have created to the **JsonDumpBot**. You will then get the channel or group ID.

- Copy this ID to a clipboard.

#### Sending form details to Telegram

- Go to **Everest Forms > All Forms**.

- Edit a form. Or, create a new form from scratch.

- Go to Form **Settings > Telegram**

Here, you can provide the name of the notification. In the Channel or Group ID, enter the group ID you generated from the steps given above.

On the Telegram Message, you can put the content of the message as per your need. Use the smart tags to map form field values. Click on the <> button and use the available form fields as smart tags.

## WooCommerce

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/woocommerce/>

With WooCommerce for Everest Forms, you can add personalized form fields to the WooCommerce product page on your website.

## Installation

- Firstly, you need to purchase the Everest Forms Pro plugin.

- After the successful purchase, you will get the plugin zip file under your WPEverest account page.

- Now, you can download the **Everest Forms Pro** from there.

- Through your WordPress Dashboard, visit **Plugins -> Add New -> Upload** and then choose the downloaded zip file and then install and activate it.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **WooCommerce** add-on and install it.

This add-on required WooCommerce plugin to be installed and activated.

## Setup and Configuration

Once you have activated the WooCommerce for Everest Forms add-on, follow the steps below.

- Go to **Products > Add New. **

- Provide the necessary details about the product as per the requirements.

- On the **Product Details** box, click on the **Everest Forms **tab.

From here, you will be able to choose the forms created with the Everest Forms plugin.

After you select the desired form, you can map the form fields to suit your needs.

That is all. You can now click the ‘**Update’ button **tosave the changes.

Now, whenever a user views the product, they will be able to fill in the data you have selected. This should be done before adding the product to the cart.

## Trello

<https://docs.everestforms.net/docs/trello/>

Connect your Everest Forms data to your Trello accounts. Use Trello API to link Everest Forms with Trello, syncing your website’s form submissions with Trello tasks.

## Installation

- Firstly, you need to purchase the Everest Forms Pro plugin.

- After the successful purchase, you will get the plugin zip file under your WPEverest account page.

- Now, you can download the **Everest Forms Pro** from there.

- Through your WordPress Dashboard, visit **Plugins -> Add New -> Upload** and then choose the downloaded zip file and then install and activate it.

- Now go to **Everest Forms > Add-ons > All Features.**

- Search **Trello** add-on and install it.

## Setup and Configuration

Once you have activated the iContact integration, go to Everest Forms > Settings > Integration > Trello and click on the settings button. This will take you to the configuration screen for the Trello integration.

You will get to the following screen.

### Getting the Trello API Key

- Either login to your Trello account or create a new account .

- Once you’re logged in, you can visit your Power-Up Admin Portal . From there, click “**Create**”.

- Click on **Create Workspace** and create a Workspace as per you requirements.

If you already have a Workspace, you can skip above steps and follow from the next.

- Go to your Power-Up Admin Portal . From there, click “**New**”.

- Enter the details as asked and click on **Create.**

- You will then be asked to **Generate a New API key.**

- Click on the **Generate a new API key **button to get your keys.

Copy this key to your clipboard and enter it on the Everest Forms > Settings > Integration > Trello. Then, click on **Get Access Token. **

You will then get an access token. Use this token to connect to the Everest Forms.

It will then be connected to the Everest Forms. If you want to disconnect this app, you can click on the Disconnect button on the far right.

Similarly, you can add multiple connections.

### Connect Trello to your contact forms

Once you have connected the Trello to the Everest Forms settings, you need to create a form to connect it to the Trello. You can connect your existing forms as well. For this, go to the following location.

All Forms > Choose a Form > Integration > Trello

- Click on **Add New Connection.**

- Provide a nickname for the connection.

- Now, you have to choose the account, Trello configuration, Board List, Board Label, Board Member, and map the form fields as required.

- Click on **Save.**

#### How to use conditional logic for Trello connections?

To use conditional logic, enable the option by ticking the ‘**Use Conditional Logic’ **option at the bottom of every connection you make.

In the above example, the form sends data to the Trello account only if the First Name is ‘Everest’.
